answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A beacon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lotus of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The grove of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
